title: AI Called Your Teen’s Friend ‘Manipulative.’ What Now?
summary: A three-question conversation to check an AI friendship verdict, stop sharing private details, and leave an ordinary next step with your teen while keeping safety in view.
seo_description: When AI labels your teen’s friend manipulative, use three questions to check the answer, protect private details and choose a teen-owned next step together.
release_move: The parent owns privacy and safety boundaries; the teen chooses whether and how to respond to an ordinary friendship uncertainty after checking the AI answer.

core_belief_shift.from: I must either accept the bot’s verdict, disprove it, or take over the friendship decision.
core_belief_shift.to: I can take my teen’s worry seriously, inspect what the AI knew, protect private details, and leave an ordinary choice with my teen.

book_relevance.reason: The Social Playbook Chapter 17 offers optional perspective-taking about incomplete information, not chatbot safety; the guide works independently.

hero.alt: An adult woman watches with concern while a teenager studies a phone at the kitchen table.

social_image.alt: A thoughtful teenager holds a phone while an adult woman watches with quiet concern.
